_comment: Pastoral notes shown on the ministry pages. byFamily / byCategory are the 'Where we stand' notes (which parts of an area we run ourselves). curation is why we send people out for the rest — it opens every family page.

byCategory.childrens-ministry: Kids are ours on a Sunday. Nursery through 5th grade, every week at 10am, with their own space and their own teaching.
byCategory.nursery: We run our own nursery every Sunday at 10am, so you can be in the service.
byCategory.high-school: We do not run a separate youth service. Our teens are in the service with us on Sunday morning, and the messages are written for 12 and up.
byCategory.middle-school: We do not run a separate youth service. Our middle schoolers are in the service with us on Sunday morning, and the messages are written for 12 and up.
byCategory.small-groups: Life Groups are ours and they stay ours. Belonging is the one thing a church cannot hand off, so we will not send you to another church's small group.
byCategory.discipleship-groups: The Welcome Path is ours: a guided next step that Elizabeth follows up on personally.
byCategory.prayer-meetings: We have a praying team that has been going longer than most of our other ministries, and a prayer chain that goes out the same day.
byCategory.intercession: Our Corporate Prayer team gathers to pray for the church and the city, and prays with anyone who asks.
byCategory.corporate-worship: Sunday at 10am is ours. Hosting His presence is the thing we have given 30 years to.
byCategory.short-term-missions: We send our own teams to Jarabacoa each summer with Mission of Hope, and have done since 2015. Any church in the city can send their people with us.
byCategory.local-outreach: Rebecca directs our outreach. When we serve the city, she is the one who knows where to point us.
byCategory.grief-support: Our pastoral care team shows up at the hospital and stays through the hard season. That is not outsourced and never has been.
byCategory.hospital-visitation: Call the church office and someone from pastoral care will call you back.
byCategory.membership-baptism: Membership and baptism run through us, starting with the Welcome Path.
byCategory.city-unity: Unify GR is ours. This whole page exists because of it.

byFamily.kids: Kids are ours on a Sunday morning. Everything else here is what the rest of the family offers through the week.
byFamily.students: Our teens worship with us on Sunday morning and our messages are written for 12 and up. Midweek is where the rest of the family gets around them.
byFamily.worship-and-prayer: Worship and prayer are our own signature. What sits here alongside them is what others open to the wider city.
byFamily.formation: Life Groups and the Welcome Path are ours. The deeper study and training below is led by others.
byFamily.mission: Mission trips and local outreach are ours. The rest is led by people already doing it well.

curation.students: A teenager needs other believing teenagers in the same hallway on Monday morning, which is why we point students toward groups inside their own school district. What they build on a Wednesday night then gets held up for the other 6 days by people they already sit near in class. It also has to be a drive a parent can actually make twice a week. You still worship with us at 10 on Sunday, and you still go home with us afterward.
curation.kids: Families run on bedtimes and car seats, and a midweek kids programme 15 minutes from your door is the one you are still going to in February.
curation.men-women: One shoe does not fit all. Some men will come to a 6am breakfast and never to a study, and some will come to a golf outing and say more on the 4th hole than they have said in a year. So we carry several of them at different hours, and you pick the one you would actually turn up to.
curation.marriage-family: Marriage work is specific. A couple in their first year and a couple in their thirtieth need different rooms, and the mothers among us need support built around what a mother's day actually looks like.
curation.formation: Depth takes teachers who have given years to it. Where somebody in this city teaches a book better than we do, we would rather send you to them than run a thinner version of it ourselves.
curation.worship-and-prayer: Prayer meetings keep different hours, and some of us can only pray at 6am while others can only pray at 9pm. The city has both, so we carry both.
curation.recovery: Recovery runs on repetition and anonymity, and it works best close to home. What matters is that there is a room open on the night you need one, not whose name is on the building.
curation.mental-health: This is licensed work and we will not improvise it. We know the counselors we would send our own family to, and those are the ones listed here.
curation.health: The clinic, the diagnosis, the disability, the last months of a life. This needs people who do it every day.
curation.practical-care: Food, housing, work, and the emergency that decides whether a family stays together. Speed matters more than whose logo is on the door. The pantry that is open tomorrow is the right pantry.
curation.justice: People who are trapped, exploited, locked up, or newly arrived with nothing are already being served by ministries who have been at it for decades. We back them rather than start something beside them.
curation.mission: We lead the trips and the local outreach. For the rest, the people already doing it well should keep doing it, and we should be sending them help.
curation.church-leaders: Pastors need care from outside their own congregation. So do their marriages.
curation.foster-adoption: Nobody should walk into a licensing process alone. These are the people who know the system.
curation.creative: Artists need other artists, and there are more of them in this city than there are in any one church.
curation.seniors: Getting there is the whole question, and close and warm on a Tuesday morning beats excellent and across town every time.
